item.name: Survivor
item.bestFor: Learning lane control before spending Credits on a class unlock.
item.soloTeamNote: Usable as the free baseline, but it falls behind stronger damage, healing, and structure classes.
item.unlockPriority: Free starter; replace with Medic or Marksman once Credits allow.

item.name: Medic
item.bestFor: Public squads, structure-heavy teams, and players who want the cheapest strong support unlock.
item.soloTeamNote: Best in co-op because healing players and structures keeps a defensive lane alive longer.
item.unlockPriority: Best cheap support unlock; buy early if your squad needs sustain.

item.name: Marksman
item.bestFor: Solo players or small groups that need direct weapon damage before expensive classes.
item.soloTeamNote: Strong first damage unlock, but it needs movement and positioning because it does not bring healing or barricades.
item.unlockPriority: Best early damage unlock; a practical first buy after Survivor.

item.name: Engineer
item.kitSummary: Flame Turret; Auto Turret; Steel Barricade
item.bestFor: Holding a chokepoint with automated damage before Tactician is affordable.
item.soloTeamNote: Works better with a Medic or teammates because structures need protection as waves scale.
item.unlockPriority: Useful structure step, but Tactician is the stronger long-term defense path.

item.name: Ninja
item.bestFor: Short escape windows, clutch movement, and players who specifically want the stealth kit.
item.soloTeamNote: Risky in later waves because the class wants closer range than most safer damage options.
item.unlockPriority: Low priority for progression; skip unless you want the stealth playstyle.

item.name: Demolitionist
item.bestFor: Stalling and punishing packed zombie groups while teammates reposition.
item.soloTeamNote: Useful for AoE pressure, but less consistent than classes that bring stronger lane control or team sustain.
item.unlockPriority: Mid-cost specialty pick; buy when pack control is the problem you need to solve.

item.name: Tactician
item.bestFor: Team holds, chokepoints, and defensive setups that need structures to target tougher enemies.
item.soloTeamNote: Pairs especially well with Medic because healing support keeps structures alive through heavy waves.
item.unlockPriority: Strong mid-progression defense goal after early Credit unlocks.

item.name: Bastion
item.bestFor: Team survival, defensive holds, and squads that want a shelter-style tool during wave spikes.
item.soloTeamNote: Strongest when the team can hold around Bunker and let automated support keep pressure off the group.
item.unlockPriority: Late goal for squad-focused players; compare against Necromancer before saving 200,000 Credits.

item.name: Necromancer
item.kitSummary: Soul Harvester; Raise Undead; Death Nova
item.bestFor: Late-wave pushes where dense zombie waves feed the soul, minion, and detonation loop.
item.soloTeamNote: Works in solo or teams, but it needs active timing so Death Nova does not erase your own frontline too early.
item.unlockPriority: Most expensive long-term damage goal; save for it after early class and weapon needs are stable.
